description: Test whether the five principal T5 single-strand interruptions lie closer to predicted sigma70 promoters than chance
code:
import requests, re, numpy as np, pandas as pd, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
E="https://eutils.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/entrez/eutils/"
fa=requests.get(E+"efetch.fcgi", params={"db":"nuccore","id":"AY587007.1","rettype":"fasta","retmode":"text"}, timeout=120).text
genome="".join(fa.split("\n")[1:]).upper()
GL=len(genome); print("genome length", GL)

# --- sigma70 promoter scan: -35 TTGACA + spacer 15-19 + -10 TATAAT, allow mismatches ---
m35="TTGACA"; m10="TATAAT"
comp=str.maketrans("ACGT","TGCA")
def rc(s): return s.translate(comp)[::-1]

def scan(seq, strand):
    L=len(seq)
    # precompute mismatch counts
    a35=np.frombuffer(m35.encode(),dtype=np.uint8); a10=np.frombuffer(m10.encode(),dtype=np.uint8)
    arr=np.frombuffer(seq.encode(),dtype=np.uint8)
    def mm(motif_arr,k):
        win=np.lib.stride_tricks.sliding_window_view(arr,k)
        return (win!=motif_arr).sum(axis=1)
    d35=mm(a35,6); d10=mm(a10,6)
    hits=[]
    for sp in range(15,20):
        n=min(len(d35), len(d10)-(6+sp))
        if n<=0: continue
        tot=d35[:n]+d10[6+sp:6+sp+n]
        idx=np.where(tot<=2)[0]          # <=2 total mismatches across 12 informative bases
        for i in idx:
            tss = i+6+sp+6+6             # approx TSS ~7 nt after -10 start
            hits.append((tss if strand=="+" else L-tss, int(tot[i]), strand, sp))
    return hits

hits = scan(genome,"+") + scan(rc(genome),"-")
P=pd.DataFrame(hits, columns=["tss","mismatches","strand","spacer"]).drop_duplicates(subset=["tss","strand"])
P=P[(P.tss>=0)&(P.tss<GL)]
print("predicted sigma70 promoters (<=2 mismatches in -35/-10):", len(P), f"= 1 per {GL/len(P):.0f} bp")

nicks={"7.9%":7.9,"18.5%":18.5,"32.6%":32.6,"64.8%":64.8,"99.6%":99.6}
tss=np.sort(P.tss.values)
def nearest(pos):
    k=np.searchsorted(tss,pos); c=[]
    if k<len(tss): c.append(tss[k]-pos)
    if k>0: c.append(pos-tss[k-1])
    return min(c)

obs=[]
for k,v in nicks.items():
    pos=int(v/100*GL); obs.append(dict(site=k, bp=pos, nearest_promoter_bp=int(nearest(pos))))
O=pd.DataFrame(obs); print("\n=== distance from each principal interruption to the nearest predicted sigma70 promoter ===")
print(O.to_string(index=False))
obs_med=np.median(O.nearest_promoter_bp); print("observed median:", obs_med, "bp")

# permutation null: 5 random positions, 20000 draws
rng=np.random.default_rng(0)
null=np.array([np.median([nearest(p) for p in rng.integers(0,GL,5)]) for _ in range(20000)])
p=(null<=obs_med).mean()
print(f"permutation null median-of-5 distance: mean {null.mean():.0f} bp, median {np.median(null):.0f} bp")
print(f"one-sided p (interruptions closer to a promoter than chance) = {p:.3f}")

fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(7.5,3.6))
ax.hist(null,bins=60,color="#B6C7DA",edgecolor="none")
ax.axvline(obs_med,color="#E45756",lw=2.5)
ax.text(obs_med,ax.get_ylim()[1]*0.9,f"  observed = {obs_med:.0f} bp\n  p = {p:.2f}",color="#E45756",fontsize=9,va="top")
ax.set_xlabel("median distance of 5 sites to nearest predicted sigma70 promoter (bp)")
ax.set_ylabel("permutations"); ax.set_title("T5 principal interruptions are not promoter-proximal")
for sp in ["right","top"]: ax.spines[sp].set_visible(False)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
